title: Divided powers on a strictly graded commutative algebra
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A=\bigoplus_{i\geq0}A_i$ a nonnegative strictly graded commutative unital $R$-algebra [def-sfb-nonnegative-strict-graded-algebra]. A graded divided-power structure on $A$ consists of maps $\gamma_n:A_{\mathrm{even},+}\to A_{\mathrm{even},+}$ for all integers $n>0$, with the convention $\gamma_0(x)=1\in A_0$. For $x,y\in A_{\mathrm{even},+}$, $a\in A_{\mathrm{even}}$ and positive integers $n,m$, the axioms are: $\gamma_1(x)=x$; $\gamma_n(x)\in A_{2in}$ whenever $x\in A_{2i}$ with $i>0$; $\gamma_n(x)\gamma_m(x)=\binom{n+m}{n}\gamma_{n+m}(x)$; $\gamma_n(ax)=a^n\gamma_n(x)$; $\gamma_n(x+y)=\sum_{b=0}^n\gamma_b(x)\gamma_{n-b}(y)$; and $\gamma_n(\gamma_m(x))=\frac{(nm)!}{n!(m!)^n}\gamma_{nm}(x)$. In addition, $\gamma_n(uv)=0$ whenever $u,v\in A_{\mathrm{odd}}$ are homogeneous and $n>1$. The factorial quotients are integers and act by repeated addition; they are not division operations in $R$. The identities involving $\gamma_0$ are interpreted in $A_{\mathrm{even}}$. No differential is part of this structure.

reviewed_lean.note: GradedAlgebra.GradedDividedPowers extends Mathlib DividedPowers (positiveEvenIdeal 𝒜) on the CommRing evenSubalgebra 𝒜, which gives the gamma_0 convention, ideal-valuedness, and the identity, product, even-scalar, addition and composition axioms (uniformBell m n = (mn)!/(m!(n!)^m) via uniformBell_mul_eq, a nat cast, no division). The new fields dpow_homogeneous (n>0, i>0, x in 𝒜(2i) gives dpow n x in 𝒜(2in)) and dpow_odd_mul (homogeneous odd x, y; z with (z:A)=x*y, which determines z; n>1 gives 0) match Stacks dpa.tex 965-1003 (09PG) and the node clause by clause. A is not assumed commutative, universes u, v are independent, and nothing is stronger than the node.
